name: inspect_managed_artifact
title: Inspect Managed Artifact
description: Inspect PE/CLI identity, classification and metadata inventories from an explicit path or selected managed target without loading or executing code. Default complete returns all producer facts; detail summary retains them and returns identity, assembly/MVID, frameworks, coverage and counts. Page references/resources/attributes with inspect_analysis_view kind managed and normalized_result.parent_evidence_id. Counts cover returned rows; partial, malformed and unavailable metadata stay explicit. Tokens are build-local. Use inspect_managed_members for methods, signatures and CIL anchors.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

__schema12.description: Verbatim direct-request path; not part of semantic identity.

__schema13.description: Verbatim auxiliary input paths keyed by argument name; repeated selections retain their order. Caller assertions are outside semantic identity.

path.description: Selected artifact path, or the canonical resource root when resource-only Evidence has no executable subject.

name: inspect_managed_members
title: Inspect Managed Members
description: Inspect PE/CLI types, members, signatures, CIL hashes/instruction tuples, exception regions, static calls, field accesses and loaded #US strings without executing code. type_names selects exact declaring types and their body literals; assembly-wide member_refs/exported_types are still included. Tokens remain local to artifact SHA-256/MVID; tuple hashes do not resolve them or fully commit control flow. Default complete returns collections; detail summary retains them for inspect_analysis_view kind managed-members using parent_evidence_id. Page types/exported_types/fields/methods/member_refs/call_edges/field_accesses/user_strings; exact names/declaring_types and fields narrow supported rows. Omit body to avoid IL anchors. Unmatched names and incomplete coverage stay explicit.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.

__schema12.description: Verbatim direct-request path; not part of semantic identity.

__schema13.description: Verbatim auxiliary input paths keyed by argument name; repeated selections retain their order. Caller assertions are outside semantic identity.

name_sha256.description: Framed nominal namespace/name/enclosing-name digest, independent of build-local rows. Null for historical Evidence or unresolved nesting; defining assemblies and CLR runtime identity are not established.

enclosing_type_token.description: Observed enclosing TypeDef from NestedClass; null when no enclosing entry was available, which alone does not establish top-level identity.

constant.description: Field-owned ECMA-335 Constant declaration and decoded default. Null means neither a declaration nor HasDefault was observed; omission means historical Evidence without this inspection.

local_var_signature.description: Validated LocalVarSig blob facts; null when absent or unrecorded. Named types, modifiers and generic variables require metadata or declaring context; equal raw digests do not establish their cross-artifact type identity.

il_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exactly the raw il_size CIL bytes; excludes the method header, locals signature, alignment, and extra sections

normalized_il_sha256.description: Member-result-v1 SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON [opcode, operand_kind, operand] tuples for a complete decode; retains build-local tokens, omits switch targets, and excludes headers, locals, and exception regions

class_token.description: Raw build-local catch type token; not a cross-artifact identity

class_type_name_sha256.description: Nested nominal TypeDef/TypeRef name digest; assembly scope is compared separately and local tokens are not cross-artifact identities

class_type_identity_resolved.description: Whether this artifact's local token identifies the reported catch type; null when unexamined

parent_name.description: Name of a TypeDef, TypeRef, or generic-instantiation TypeSpec parent; null for other parents or when unknown

target_identity_sha256.description: Nominal declaring-type/name/signature digest; null when unresolved or unrecorded. Does not establish assembly or runtime binding.

target_name.description: Method name; a method-spec target reports its generic method

target_declaring_type.description: Declaring type of the called method; null when unknown

target_identity_sha256.description: Nominal declaring-type/name/signature digest; null when unresolved or unrecorded. Does not establish assembly or runtime binding.

field_declaring_type.description: Declaring type of the accessed field; null when unknown

value.description: Decoded UTF-16 code units, excluding the terminal flag byte; unpaired surrogates are kept

path.description: Selected artifact path, or the canonical resource root when resource-only Evidence has no executable subject.

__schema17.description: Signature type-name resolution was examined, including unresolved operands; v2 also renders readable operand names, v1 retains raw operand text; null means no attestation, including historical or capacity-limited Evidence.

__schema29.description: Whether all NestedClass rows were read and valid. Null for historical Evidence; false means current nesting is incomplete. Individual name digests can remain unresolved for missing, cyclic or over-deep enclosing chains.

resolved_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw signature with each TypeDef or TypeRef operand replaced by that type's namespace-qualified name; equals raw_sha256 when the signature names no types. Unlike raw_sha256 it does not depend on build-local metadata rows. Null when the signature could not be decoded or names a type REA could not resolve, such as a TypeSpec.

value.description: Encoded scalar, not runtime state. i8/u8 are decimal strings; negative zero and nonfinite floats are -0/NaN/Infinity/-Infinity strings. Null is a decoded class null only when state is decoded.

__schema51.description: Examined zero-based MethodDef row interval before declaring-type selection; null means the row scope was not recorded. Row coordinates are build-local and cannot prove cross-build member absence for a page.

name: inspect_managed_native_boundaries
title: Inspect Managed Native Boundaries
description: Inspect PE/CLI ModuleRef, ImplMap/PInvoke declarations, CLI native-header indicators, and non-IL method implementation flags without loading or executing target code. Results are managed declarations and degraded native-boundary observations, not verified native exports or addresses.
